title: US stocks:  US market posts weekly gains with earnings, inflation data on tap
description: Wall Street finished strong on Friday, fueled by optimism ahead of the third-quarter earnings reports from major players like Wells Fargo and Goldman Sachs. Analysts predict a notable growth in S&P 500 earnings year-over-year, even as worries about consumer sentiment loom. Oil prices dipped initially due to conflicting US-Iran news but later recovered. Moreover, significant companies such as Delta Air Lines and Apple reported hurdles impacting their respective stock performances.

title: Gold, silver boom puts US bank trading revenues on track for record $5 billion
description: In the first half of 2026, the precious metals desks at major banks achieved significant earnings due to high demand. JPMorgan Chase reported approximately $700 million in profits from trading gold, silver, and other metals. Deutsche Bank also returned to bullion trading, earning more than $200 million in the same period. Analysts predict that banks will generate around $5 billion from precious metals trading by the end of the year.

title: US bull market nears fourth anniversary, but narrow rally raises risks
description: The ongoing US stock bull market is nearing its fourth anniversary with strong corporate earnings and low volatility. Investor concerns are rising due to the disparity between benchmark indices and the performance of individual stocks. The reliance on artificial intelligence for growth makes the market susceptible to volatility if sentiment shifts. Upcoming third-quarter earnings and midterm elections could introduce additional uncertainties for investors.

title: Anthem Biosciences block deal: Portsmouth Technologies sells 30 lakh shares worth Rs 250 crore
description: Portsmouth Technologies LLC executed a block deal selling 30 lakh shares of Anthem Biosciences on October 9. The shares were sold at Rs 833 each, totaling Rs 249.90 crore. Following this transaction, Portsmouth's estimated stake in the company would decrease significantly. Anthem Biosciences reported a decline in total income and profit after tax for the first quarter of FY27.

title: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 profit surges fivefold as income rises
description: Poonawalla Fincorp reported a substantial increase in net profit for the second quarter, rising over fivefold. The company's net interest income and fee income grew significantly, contributing to the profit surge. New loan products accounted for a notable percentage of disbursements during this period, demonstrating the diversification of their offerings. Additionally, improvements in the gross non-performing asset ratio reflect better asset quality management.

title: Rupee recovers to 96.73 vs US dollar after RBI intervention, but dollar demand persists
description: The rupee edged up to 96.73 per dollar after heavy RBI intervention helped it recover intraday. Persistent corporate dollar demand, a 7% year-to-date decline and falling forex reserves continued to weigh on sentiment.

title: US stocks: US market rises as oil retreats; SpaceX spectrum deal hammers telecoms
description: Wall Street opened on a positive note this Friday as oil prices dipped, easing worries over Middle Eastern supply issues. The Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Composite each experienced a rise at the open. Nonetheless, the telecom industry faced headwinds following SpaceX's spectrum purchase, sparking competitive anxiety among its players, showcasing the market's mixed responses to sector-specific events.

title: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 Results: Profit skyrockets 407% YoY to Rs 375 crore, NII rises 81%
